run.question:
Alertmanager alert PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus since 2026-11-15T04:33:19Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The alert rule itself is present and its firing condition is 'fewer than one Alertmanager discovered'. In this cluster the complete enumerations show no Alertmanager component at all: 66 pods, 52 services, 6 StatefulSets (only clickhouse, jaeger-traces-recorder, prometheus-alert-recorder, topology-monitor, opensearch, and the prometheus StatefulSet) and 72 ServiceAccounts contain nothing named alertmanager, and the prometheus namespace's 5 Services/5 Endpoints cover only operator, kube-state-metrics, prometheus and node-exporter. So Prometheus prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus has zero Alertmanager targets to discover, which is exactly what PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers reports. The alert's own driving series (prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered) could not be read: the queryable Prometheus registry returned no prometheus_* series for the window, so that value is unknown, not zero, and the Alertmanager custom resources themselves are not readable with the permitted object kinds. Timing: the rule-file ConfigMap was created 2026-11-15T04:26:25Z and the current Prometheus pod object was created 2026-11-15T04:32:47Z, ~32s before the alert start; the cause of that pod re-creation is unverified (no events retained, pod logs unavailable). The alert's presence does not imply a working Alertmanager: data-recorders/prometheus-alert-recorder reads Prometheus's own API (PROMETHEUS_ENDPOINT=http://prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus.prometheus.svc.cluster.local:9090).

claims.text: Cluster-wide enumeration returned 66 pods and the list of pods whose name matches 'alertmanager' (case-insensitive) was empty.
Cluster-wide enumeration returned 52 services and the list of services whose name matches 'alertmanager' (case-insensitive) was empty.

Cluster-wide there are 6 StatefulSets and none is an Alertmanager: clickhouse/chi-clickhouse-main-0-0, data-recorders/jaeger-traces-recorder, data-recorders/prometheus-alert-recorder, kube-system/topology-monitor, opensearch/opensearch-cluster-master, prometheus/prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus.

Cluster-wide enumeration returned 72 ServiceAccounts and the list whose name matches 'alertmanager' was empty; in namespace prometheus the 5 ServiceAccounts are default, prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator, prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus, prometheus-kube-state-metrics and prometheus-prometheus-node-exporter.

In namespace prometheus the complete listings show 8 pods (operator, kube-state-metrics, prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 with two containers, 5 node-exporter pods) and 5 Endpoints (prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator 100.96.4.60:10250, prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus 100.96.5.74:9090,8080, prometheus-kube-state-metrics 100.96.5.42:8080, prometheus-operated 100.96.5.74:9090, prometheus-prometheus-node-exporter :9100); no pod and no endpoint belongs to an Alertmanager.

In namespace prometheus the only StatefulSet is prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus (labels chart=kube-prometheus-stack-77.12.0, release=prometheus), created 2026-11-14T05:19:19Z, and the only Deployments are prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator and prometheus-kube-state-metrics, both created 2026-11-14T05:19:18Z.

The rule-file ConfigMap prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-rulefiles-0 contains alert PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers with expression max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1 (runbook prometheusnotconnectedtoalertmanagers); the same file also contains the alert whose runbook is prometheuserrorsendingalertstosomealertmanagers.

The Prometheus container mounts the volume prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-rulefiles-0, i.e. the rule-file ConfigMap holding the PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers rule; its config is /etc/prometheus/config_out/prometheus.env.yaml rendered by the config-reloader from /etc/prometheus/config/prometheus.yaml.gz.

The rule-file ConfigMap prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-rulefiles-0 was created 2026-11-15T04:26:25Z, the current pod object prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 was created 2026-11-15T04:32:47Z (both containers ready, restartCounts 0), i.e. the pod object is younger than its StatefulSet (created 2026-11-14T05:19:19Z).

The alertmanager CRDs alertmanagers.monitoring.coreos.com (v1) and alertmanagerconfigs.monitoring.coreos.com (v1alpha1) are installed in the cluster, so the operator knows the Alertmanager type even though no Alertmanager workload, Service, Endpoints or ServiceAccount exists.

The pod prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator-57d68989cc-hkbnh (container kube-prometheus-stack, prometheus-operator:v0.85.0) and prometheus-kube-state-metrics-7c5fb9d798-tqssx are Running with ready=true and restartCount 0 at query time.

data-recorders/prometheus-alert-recorder-0 is Running, ready, restartCount 0, created 2026-11-15T04:40:39Z, and its container 'recorder' has env PROMETHEUS_ENDPOINT=http://prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus.prometheus.svc.cluster.local:9090, so it reads Prometheus's own API rather than an Alertmanager.

Primary cause: this kube-prometheus-stack release runs with no Alertmanager deployed, so Prometheus has zero Alertmanagers to discover and the rule max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1 evaluates true; the missing StatefulSet, Service, Endpoints and ServiceAccount in namespace prometheus support this, but the discovered-count series itself could not be read.

Timing hypothesis: the alert first fired at 04:33:19Z only ~32s after the current Prometheus pod object started at 04:32:47Z and ~7 minutes after the rule-file ConfigMap was created at 04:26:25Z, so the alerting rule (and thus this condition) was most likely (re)applied to Prometheus shortly before the alert started rather than the Alertmanager connectivity breaking then; no events or logs are available to confirm what caused the rule/config and pod changes.

Alternative candidate not supported by observed evidence: an Alertmanager custom resource may exist while the operator has not materialized a StatefulSet/Service for it (operator reconciliation problem); the operator pod is Running with restartCount 0 and no failure signal was observed, but the Alertmanager resource objects are not readable with the permitted kinds and the operator/prometheus logs returned no lines, so this remains open.

Reachability failure to an existing Alertmanager (network policy, wrong host/port, TLS) is rejected as the cause: no Alertmanager Service or Endpoints exist in namespace prometheus for Prometheus to fail to reach, and the firing rule tests the number of discovered/configured Alertmanagers (< 1), not send success; a repeated send failure to a configured Alertmanager would instead relate to the separate rule whose runbook is prometheuserrorsendingalertstosomealertmanagers.

The alert reaching the investigation pipeline does not prove an Alertmanager is reachable: the only alert-recording workload found, data-recorders/prometheus-alert-recorder, is configured solely with PROMETHEUS_ENDPOINT pointing at http://prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus.prometheus.svc.cluster.local:9090, so alert state can be read from Prometheus's own API with no Alertmanager involved.

gaps: The series that drives the alert, prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered, was not returned by any query: get_metric_names for prometheus_notifications.*, prometheus_.*, .*alertmanager.*, kube_.* and the instant query for prometheus_build_info/up/prometheus_notifications_* all returned no data for 2026-11-15T03:33:19Z-05:23:14Z, so its value is unknown, not zero.

Alertmanager custom resources (monitoring.coreos.com/v1 Alertmanager / AlertmanagerConfig) cannot be read with the permitted object kinds, so whether an Alertmanager resource exists in prometheus or any other namespace is unknown.

Secrets cannot be read, so the operator-generated Prometheus configuration (whether spec.alerting/alertmanagers is empty) and the Helm release values (e.g. alertmanager.enabled) could not be verified.

Pod and container logs were unavailable for every pod queried: prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 (init-config-reloader, prometheus, config-reloader), prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator-57d68989cc-hkbnh and data-recorders/prometheus-alert-recorder-0 all returned 0 lines read, so no log-level confirmation exists for alertmanager configuration or reconciliation.

No Kubernetes events were retained in namespace prometheus for the incident window (0 items), so the reason the pod object prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 is dated 2026-11-15T04:32:47Z while its StatefulSet dates from 2026-11-14T05:19:19Z is unverified.

list_prometheus_rules returned no data for rule name PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers, so whether the rule group is loaded in the live Prometheus could not be confirmed from the rules API; the rule was only confirmed in the mounted rule-file ConfigMap.

All Kubernetes object state is the cluster at query time (~2026-11-15T05:23-05:25Z), after the alert started at 04:33:19Z; the cluster object state at the alert's start cannot be proven, and no change-history integration is available to show whether an Alertmanager was ever deployed or deleted.
Whether any Alertmanager exists outside this cluster (which would still leave this Prometheus unconnected) is unknown and was not checked.
next_steps: Verify directly on the source of truth whether an Alertmanager custom resource exists and what the Prometheus resource's alerting section contains: kubectl -n prometheus get alertmanager,alertmanagerconfig, and kubectl -n prometheus get prometheus prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus -o yaml (look for spec.alerting.alertmanagers).

Check the live Prometheus view of its Alertmanager discovery: curl http://prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus.prometheus.svc.cluster.local:9090/api/v1/alertmanagers and the prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered series, which the investigation's metrics registry did not expose.

Confirm the release intent: inspect the kube-prometheus-stack Helm values / release manifest to see whether alertmanager.enabled was set to false (which would make this alert expected), and whether Alertmanager was intentionally omitted in this environment.

If alert delivery is required, deploy/enable the Alertmanager component (Alertmanager CR plus its StatefulSet/Service in namespace prometheus) so prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered becomes >= 1, or silence the PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers rule for environments where Alertmanager is intentionally absent.

Retrieve Prometheus, prometheus-operator and prometheus-alert-recorder container logs from the node or log backend (current API reads returned 0 lines) to confirm the alertmanager configuration and what changed at 04:26-04:33Z.
